name: grok-build-desktop
description: Grok Build 桌面端：通过 ACP 调用本机 grok CLI 的 Electron 界面
author: Grok Build Desktop

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5174 && npm run build:main && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron .
scripts.test: esbuild tests/plan-flow.test.ts tests/plugin-commands.test.ts tests/plugin-ui.test.tsx tests/mcp-commands.test.ts tests/skills.test.ts tests/extensions-ui.test.tsx tests/tab-refresh-gate.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:electron=./tests/electron-shim.ts --outdir=.test-dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs && node --test .test-dist/plan-flow.test.cjs .test-dist/plugin-commands.test.cjs .test-dist/plugin-ui.test.cjs .test-dist/mcp-commands.test.cjs .test-dist/skills.test.cjs .test-dist/extensions-ui.test.cjs .test-dist/tab-refresh-gate.test.cjs
scripts.pack:win: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release:win: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
